displayName: Event Triggered Execution: Python Startup Hooks

tests.name: Python Startup Hook - atomic_hook.pth (Windows)
tests.description:
Executes code by placing a .pth file in the site-packages directory. 
Supports python.exe and python3.exe via input arguments.

tests.name: Python Startup Hook - usercustomize.py (Windows)
tests.description:
Executes code via usercustomize.py. This is a per-user persistence mechanism 
that does not require Administrative privileges.

tests.name: Python Startup Hook - atomic_hook.pth (Linux)
tests.description:
Executes code by creating atomic_hook.pth in the site-packages directory. 
This script runs automatically for every user on the system when Python starts.

tests.name: Python Startup Hook - atomic_hook.pth (macOS)
tests.description: Creates a Python startup hook using a .pth file inside a virtual environment on macOS.

tests.name: Python Startup Hook - usercustomize.py (Linux / MacOS)
tests.description:
Executes code via usercustomize.py. This is a per-user persistence mechanism 
that does not require root privileges.
